story.text: 홍대 거리는 형형색색의 간판들로 화려하게 빛나고 있었다. 규현은 아이스크림을 하나씩 사서 건네며 앞장서 걸었다.
story.reading: hong-dae geo-ri-neun hyeong-hyeong-saek-saeg-ui gan-pan-deul-lo hwa-lyeo-ha-ge bit-na-go iss-eot-da. gyu-hyeon-eun a-i-seu-keu-lim-eul ha-na-ssik sa-seo geon-ne-myeo ap-jang-seo geol-eot-da.
story.en: Hongdae's streets glittered with colorful signs of every kind. Kyuhyun bought us each an ice cream and led the way, walking ahead.

story.text: "우와, 이 거리 진짜 신기하다!" 나는 두리번거리며 감탄했다.
story.reading: "u-wa, i geo-ri jin-jja sin-gi-ha-da!" na-neun du-ri-beon-geo-ri-myeo gam-tan-haet-da.
story.en: "Wow, this street is seriously amazing!" I marveled, looking all around.

story.text: 그때 갑자기 근처 버스킹 공연자가 화려하게 백덤블링을 선보였다. 나는 깜짝 놀라 소리쳤다. "헐, 대박!"
story.reading: geu-ttae gap-ja-gi geun-cheo beo-seu-king gong-yeon-ja-ga hwa-lyeo-ha-ge baek-deom-beul-ling-eul seon-bo-yeot-da. na-neun kkam-jjak nol-la so-ri-chyeot-da. "heol, dae-bak!"
story.en: Just then, a street performer nearby suddenly pulled off a flashy backflip. Startled, I blurted out, "Whoa, no way!"

story.text: 규현이 낄낄 웃었다. "'대박'이라고 하는 거예요, 아가씨. 그게 원래 표현이에요." 그가 네온사인을 손가락으로 가리켰다.
story.reading: gyu-hyeon-i kkil-kkil us-eot-da. "'dae-bak'-i-ra-go ha-neun geo-ye-yo, a-ga-ssi. geu-ge won-lae pyo-hyeon-i-e-yo." geu-ga ne-on-sa-in-eul son-ga-rag-eu-ro ga-ri-kyeot-da.
story.en: Kyuhyun chuckled. "That's called saying 'daebak,' miss. That's the original expression." He pointed at the neon sign with his finger.

story.text: 나는 조심스레 그 말을 따라했다. "다...대박?" 규현이 손뼉을 치며 웃었다. "그렇지! 인정!"
story.reading: na-neun jo-sim-seu-re geu mal-eul tta-ra-haet-da. "da...dae-bak?" gyu-hyeon-i son-ppyeog-eul chi-myeo us-eot-da. "geu-reoh-ji! in-jeong!"
story.en: I cautiously repeated the word. "D-daebak?" Kyuhyun clapped and laughed. "That's it! I approve!"

story.text: "레알 잘하는데요?" 그가 눈을 크게 뜨며 감탄하는 척했다. "'레알'은 '진짜'라는 뜻이에요."
story.reading: "le-al jal-ha-neun-de-yo?" geu-ga nun-eul keu-ge tteu-myeo gam-tan-ha-neun cheog-haet-da. "'le-al'-eun 'jin-jja'-ra-neun tteus-i-e-yo."
story.en: "For real, you're good at this?" He widened his eyes, pretending to be impressed. "'Leal' means 'really' or 'for real.'"

story.text: 붕어빵 노점 앞에 늘어선 긴 줄을 보고 나는 한숨을 쉬며 중얼거렸다. "아, 완전 킹받네, 배고픈데." 규현이 큰 소리로 웃음을 터뜨렸다. "방금 그거, 완벽했어요."
story.reading: bung-eo-ppang no-jeom ap-e neul-eo-seon gin jul-eul bo-go na-neun han-sum-eul swi-myeo jung-eol-geo-ryeot-da. "a, wan-jeon king-bat-ne, bae-go-peun-de." gyu-hyeon-i keun so-ri-ro us-eum-eul teo-tteu-lyeot-da. "bang-geum geu-geo, wan-byeok-haet-eo-yo."
story.en: Seeing the long line in front of the fish-shaped bread stall, I sighed and muttered, "Ugh, that's so infuriating, and I'm hungry." Kyuhyun burst out laughing loudly. "That was perfect, just now."

story.text: 붕어빵을 한입 베어 물며 규현이 덧붙였다. "이렇게 하나씩 늘려 가면, 아가씨도 곧 진짜 한국 사람 다 됐다고 할걸요?"
story.reading: bung-eo-ppang-eul han-ib be-eo mul-myeo gyu-hyeon-i deot-but-yeot-da. "i-reoh-ge ha-na-ssik neul-lyeo ga-myeon, a-ga-ssi-do got jin-jja han-guk sa-ram da dwaet-da-go hal-geol-yo?"
story.en: Taking a bite of the fish-shaped bread, Kyuhyun added, "If you keep picking these up one by one, people will soon say you're basically a real Korean."

words.meaning: I agree, fair enough (slang for acknowledging something)
to be so infuriating, so annoying (slang)
